newsitem.title: USA: Computerized Thermal starts clinical trial.
newsitem.headline: Computerized Thermal starts clinical trial.

text.p: Computerized Thermal Imaging Inc said Thursday its Thermal Medical Imaging unit has begun clinical trials of its breast imaging system. The system has been in preclinical testing since last year.

The system uses specialized computer algorithms to analyze images of the breast, which facilitates the identification of suspicious regions, the company said. It said clinical trials will test whether the data gathered from its imaging system enhances that derived from mammograms and clinical palpitation, two standards for breast imaging.
